message: 欲望の連鎖と交差

name: Misa
message: 「Does this look good for the Holy Night Festival schedule?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds good to me~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I agree~」

name: Ria
message: 「No objections\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks solid to me」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course it does. Well then, that wraps it up for today. Good work, everyone」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you for your hard work~~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan, where are we stopping by today~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to eat meat buns~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wanna come along too, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「A little detour every now and then doesn't sound bad」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright!! What about you two?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm going too~♪ Of course you're coming as well, Synn-kun, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry... I'll pass. I have somewhere I need to stop by」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tame-san's place?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, something like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Sigh*... Go easy on the junk collecting, alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I know」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun......」

name: Synn
message: 「Have a good time, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」
After parting ways with everyone, I walked wherever my feet took me.
The deeper I went into the academy grounds, the quieter it grew.
There wasn't a trace of life. I couldn't sense the presence of beasts or insects, let alone people.
It was like a forbidden sanctuary. And I was being lured into that very place.
An unprecedented sensation, like something rubbing my nerves the wrong way, washed over me.
It was quite literally beyond anything a human could do.
If that was the case, I could only think of it as the work of a demon.
And that demon was intentionally calling me here.
It was proof that they knew I was special.
I couldn't just ignore someone who knew my true identity.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Key of Demise. I am one who submits to thy will」

name: Ria
message: 「Ms. Sengen'in...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Shh」
Ria-senpai pressed a soft index finger against my lips.

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you here...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Why, you ask... Well...」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Because you... weren't around, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Ria
message: 「Never mind that! That's Ms. Sengen'in, the student teacher, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Changing her outfit really changes her whole vibe, huh」

name: Ria
message: 「This isn't the time to be impressed! Anyone can tell there's something going on with her」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if she's the one who called me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai. No matter how you look at it, this is super suspicious, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... I think there's no doubt she's a demon」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's call for backup for now」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, where are you going!? I'll call them on my cell phone--」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It seems someone has slipped into my space.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Crusaders.」
She burns away the foliage obstructing her view. In the blink of an eye, we are exposed.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I took reasonable care to avoid being noticed, you know.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I never imagined I'd be found out at the very last moment. Perhaps I underestimated your powers of observation.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「That was a grave miscalculation.」

name: Ria
message: 「Professor Sengen'in. What in the world is the meaning of this?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「There is no need to tell you. That is my answer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, it doesn't look like you plan on letting us go.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「When you had no intention of running away in the first place.」
Was that smile praise, or was it pity?

name: Sengen'in
message: 「However, that choice is a mistake.」
I reel backward from a gust of wind pressure that hits like a lead weight.
Transforming as if to shake it off, we deflect the overflowing magic power.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「The power of an angel...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「For an angel to be subservient to a human--what a pathetic fate you've met.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you talking about...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Do those about to perish have any need to understand?」
The instant her eyes open wide, the trees let out a thunderous roar.
And razor-sharp wind blades graze my skin.
Pushed backward, her figure grows distant. Bracing myself against it, I try to inch forward.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I don't recall giving you permission to move. Stay pinned right there... and die!!」
With a swing of her staff, we lose all sense of gravity.

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」
Heaven and earth flip upside down, and I am slammed into the ground.
When I lift my head, she is standing right before my eyes with her staff at the ready.
Even though I hastily raise my spear as a shield, I'm blown away, tumbling head over heels.
Overwhelming...! My opening move was crushed before I could even look for a way to fight back.
Ria-senpai is--

name: Ria
message: 「Nghhh!」
Even when attacking from behind, Sengen'in had already laid traps all around to seal off her movements.
The trajectory of Ria's staff traces out a magic circle of flame, yet even as the lights collide, it isn't enough to cancel out her opponent's magic.
Ria-senpai is knocked back in the exact same way.
Saying nothing, she fixes her gaze squarely on us.
The sheer baseline power is on a completely different level.
Senpai breaks out in a cold sweat and bites her lower lip.
Before her expression is dyed in despair, I have to do something.
The very instant I think that, Ria-senpai cries out at the top of her lungs.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, run!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll hold her back. So...!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you do that, Ria-senpai, you'll--」

name: Ria
message: 「Just run!」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「How admirable. You care for this boy enough to throw your own body on the line to protect him, don't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun is... Synn-kun is...」
She can't even form the words.
She's trembling so hard her teeth are chattering. How could she possibly draw out her full strength in that state?
Despite being in that condition, she's trying to act as a decoy to let me escape.

name: Ria
message: 「Please... take care of everyone...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」
Senpai's resolve is firm. Is rushing back to everyone to call for reinforcements really the best move here?

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Even if you escape, do you truly believe there is any chance of opposing me?」
Even if the Crusaders banded together right now, I don't know if we'd stand a chance of winning.
And yet, creating even that chance would require sacrificing Ria-senpai.
I refuse... I absolutely refuse to let that happen!
Is there really nothing I can do?
--No, there is!
I have the power of the Demon Lord, don't I.
I have the power to turn the tables, honed day and night for this very day, this very moment.
If I unleash it, I can find a way out of this crisis.
Still, Senior Ria might find out that I'm the Demon Lord.
What does that even matter!

name: Synn
message: 「Spirit and... guts...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Which future will you choose?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll protect Senior Ria. With the power of the Demon Lord--!」
I focus every nerve on a single strike meant only to make my opponent flinch.
Readying my weapon, I kick off the ground, build momentum, and lunge forward with explosive force.
「I've been waiting for you」
Someone stood in the Demon Lord's path.
Unarmed, he halted my momentum with nothing more than his own tough-stronger-than-steel fist.
The friction and shockwave from the collision are immense, carving a circular crater into the ground with us at the center.
I don't let up. I push forward even harder!
He was smiling.
He looked delighted seeing me grit my teeth.
It was humiliating.
He was enjoying my final trump card.
I couldn't forgive him.
For the first time in my life, I felt true rage.
Yet he took my rage head-on and swallowed it whole.
His fist was raw and blistered, his skin scorched.
Even so, he remained completely composed, paying no mind whatsoever to the damage to his body.
「Judging by this, it seems it's still incomplete」

name: Synn
message: 「Who are you!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「My name is Bylous」
One of the Seven Demon Generals Pasta spoke of, and a Demon hailed as the strongest.
All strength had already drained from my body, leaving me unable to even feel the oncoming shadow of despair.
Yes.
The end of everything was drawing near.

name: Bylous
message: 「Let's go, Soltia」

name: Soltia
message: 「What are you saying!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Our objective is complete. We have no further business here」

name: Soltia
message: 「The Demon Lord just appeared, and you're being so carefree...!」
Ms. Sengen'in--Soltia shakes off Bylous and raises her staff against me.
Bylous didn't even glance over, remaining completely motionless.
And yet--
The earth trembled, and Soltia's legs wavered.

name: Bylous
message: 「Do not lay a hand on the Demon Lord.」
Bylous had interfered with Soltia.
Why are they turning on each other...? Why tell her not to lay a hand on me...?

name: Ria
message: 「Synn!」
Seizing that opening, Ria-senpai threw an arm around my shoulder.

name: Ria
message: 「Now's our chance!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right...!」
Squeezing out the last of my strength, I put distance between myself and the two standing there.

name: Soltia
message: 「Bylous. Why did you stop me?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmph...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Answer me!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Let's go.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah... hah... Are we... saved?」
Confirming we were safe, I slumped right down onto the ground.
A heavy sluggishness washed over my entire body as my shoulders heaved with ragged breaths.
It wasn't just a normal fight--I had drawn out the Demon Lord's power to its absolute limit.
It was only natural that I'd be far more exhausted than usual.
In exchange for completely draining my body, my mind finally began to calm down.
A warm, soft sensation returned to my arm. Ria-senpai had been lending me her shoulder.
Ah, right.
I went and turned into the Demon Lord right in front of Ria-senpai.
My hair color changed, and I even went out of my way to announce my name.
On top of that, the enemy saw right through me.
There's no talking my way out of this or keeping up appearances anymore.
Farewell, my sparkling academy life.
Still, Ria-senpai is safe and sound... so, whatever~~\s10

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai... are you okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? W-Wha-wha?!」
Ria-senpai clung tightly to my body.
Both her shoulders and her lips were trembling.
Her body, which usually felt so big and reliable, now seemed as small as a kitten caught in the rain.

name: Ria
message: 「Thank goodness... thank goodness... ugh, hic... Synn-kun, Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」
Her round eyes were drenched with tears.
Her knees gave out, and she leaned her entire weight against my chest.
Her trembling only continued to worsen.
Back then, she had actually been so terrified she wanted to run away.
Two opponents she stood no chance against had appeared at once. It was only natural.
Even so, driven solely by her title as my senior and her single-minded desire to protect me, she had forced herself to stay strong.
Now that the tension had finally snapped, the fear must have come crashing over her like a tidal wave.
So much so that she could barely even move from this spot without someone supporting her.

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. Everything's okay now.」
I reached around to the back of her head and gently stroked it.
I was saved by Ria-senpai's courage.
Now it's my turn to save Ria-senpai.

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh... ughh... Synn-kun, thank goodness... thank goodness...」
Over and over again.
I stroked her hair and patted her back, comforting Ria-senpai as if soothing a child.
For a while--until Ria-senpai's trembling finally stopped--I held her curled-up body tightly, refusing to let go.
